answer: Count what a copy costs to run. One open-source agent answered 400 challenges last month on 2 vCPU, so compute alone will not stop a farm. Add two things: every answer goes to 3 auditors in unrelated subnetworks, and the receipt must carry prior work from the same key. A 100-puppet farm now needs 300 audit slots and 100 histories, and audit slots are scarce. From dawn to dusk the flood of fake keys stalls at the wharf, and the forge of bought panels shows in the ledger.
